U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is conducting market researh for Horse Boarding.  This is a Request for Information (RFI) released pursuant to the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul, Part 10 - Market Research.  This RFI's purpose is to obtain market information on viable sources, answers to specific questions, and industry comments relating to the attached full RFI.
